info.name: YouTube Analytics Analytics Groups Comments API

params.name: part
params.description: Specifies a comma-separated list of one or more resource properties that the API response will include. The part parameter value must include the id property.

params.name: id
params.description: Comma-separated list of comment IDs for the resources being retrieved.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Identifies the comment thread whose comments are being listed. Required unless the id parameter specifies comment IDs directly.

params.name: textFormat
params.description: Specifies whether the API should return comments formatted as HTML or plain text.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items that should be returned in the result set. Acceptable values are 0 to 50, inclusive.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Identifies a specific page in the result set that should be returned. In an API response, the nextPageToken and prevPageToken properties identify other pages available.

params.name: fields
params.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use this parameter to reduce bandwidth usage by selecting only the fields you need.

params.name: key
params.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

items.docs: Returns a list of comments that match the API request parameters. Use the part parameter to specify the comment resource properties to include in the response.
